svg.title: Plate 001 — Qwen3-8B Base: 1,680 real trials
svg.desc: F16: 72.50%, 174 of 240 successes; Q8_0: 73.75%, 177 of 240 successes; Q6_K: 74.17%, 178 of 240 successes; Q5_K_M: 70.42%, 169 of 240 successes; Q4_K_M: 70.83%, 170 of 240 successes; Q3_K_M: 65.42%, 157 of 240 successes; Q2_K: 1.25%, 3 of 240 successes. Every mark is a measurement. All 80 tasks appear in the same row-major order for each condition, with three measured traces per task.
